rows.definition: Vulkan fused wrapper helper checking all selected weight-slot pointers have sufficient nominal resident buffer bytes while their live owners and command-stream lock are retained.
rows.distinction: These slots are expert weight bindings, unlike the scheduler Slot free/busy signal. The helper checks nominal bytes only and does not validate stale aliases, device generations, or dispatch-grid limits.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q2_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, validated byte extents and the workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result, not a recorded Vulkan command buffer or a device qualification claim.

rows.definition: Pure planner that validates Q2_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q2KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Performs host arithmetic admission only; the returned plan holds geometry while provider capability and opt-in decide whether native execution is available.

rows.definition: Pure bounded Q3_K token-panel geometry carrying output/input widths, exactly 2/4/8 rows, 110-byte quantized block extents padded to four bytes, and workgroup count for the three-int32 shader push ABI.
rows.distinction: An immutable launch geometry result for Q3_K storage rather than Q2_K geometry or a recorded Vulkan command buffer; does not qualify native device execution.

rows.definition: Pure planner validating Q3_K matrix geometry, block divisibility, padded 110-byte block storage, signed 32-bit byte bounds and exactly 2/4/8 token rows before returning V41Q3KTokenPanelPlan.
rows.distinction: Host arithmetic admission for Q3_K storage; the result contains geometry while provider capability and opt-in independently control execution. Distinct from the Q2_K planner.
